description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: machine-local ignored configuration and generated dependencies/assets only in ../zaq-feat-attach-documents; no application edits. Resume worktree-setup from missing .claude/settings.local.json, using a user-provided/authorized local source in PR6, never modifying PR5 or silently copying another contributor's settings. Current source path is absent, so skill step 5 is blocked and mix setup must not run until resolved. Preserve the copied dev.secret and avoid printing secrets. Confirm effective dev/test database isolation and environment overrides before setup; dev Config.Reader already resolves zaq_feat_attach_documents. Verify toolchain/PostgreSQL extensions and then execute authorized mix setup sequentially through Context Mode. Document exact failure if it fails and stop setup at that step; do not change dependency pins to force setup.
Tests to add before implementation: no new application tests for environment setup. Verify branch feat/attach-documents, captured parent 81629c90a555b32c6b66cbcc1339779c89f4a9d5, no tracked delta, secret equality without output, private config presence, effective isolated DB, successful migrations/assets/dependencies before claiming readiness. Record no-test exception for setup only.
Branches/paths validated: absent local settings (current blocker), existing isolated environment, DB_NAME override/nonisolated DB refusal, dependency or migration failure, successful setup. No shared DB reset or PR5 build mutation.
Mocking plan: none; read actual config and run real setup only after the missing input is resolved. No global config mutation or arbitrary software installs.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: Beadwork setup evidence/blocker only; use docs/dev-setup.md and skill as owners, no new setup manual.
Action reuse assessment: not applicable to setup; no executable application operation changes. Runtime installation is environment work, not a new Action. Acceptance requires fresh setup evidence, not predecessor validation.

Implementation constraints: This is a proposed plan only. The current request authorizes setup and Beadwork planning, not implementation, commits, pushes, rebases or publication. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before later execution; read the owning service guide and each touched module's @moduledoc. Agent work also follows docs/services/agent.md#harness-critical-checks-for-coding-agents. Recheck live source/contracts after PR5 advances. Preserve existing test behavior; if an assertion/scenario must change, record old/proposed behavior and obtain specific human approval first. No such changes are approved here. New unit/integration/property tests are immediate and written before production code. Keep real internal boundaries and isolated fixture/process state; inject runtime dependencies through established opts/context and Zaq.Config.get/4 where relevant, without global configuration mutation. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not treat historical/reference runs as current validation. PR5 owns delivery execution/outcomes; PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
